parsed_json.up: Select activity_id, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id as molecule_chembl_id, target_dictionary.chembl_id as target_chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name as target_name, standard_type, standard_value, standard_units. Join activities with molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno equals molecule_dictionary.molregno. Join assays on activities.assay_id equals assays.assay_id. Join target_dictionary on assays.tid equals target_dictionary.tid. Filter target_dictionary.organism equals 'Homo sapiens', target_dictionary.target_type equals 'SINGLE PROTEIN', standard_units equals 'nM', standard_type in EC50, IC50, AC50, and standard_value less than 50. Return distinct rows. Sort by activity_id ascending. Limit to 200.
